title: Reservation with crosstalk — follow the caller's final corrected request
caller_goal: Book a dinner reservation; another person nearby talks over the caller with conflicting details.

script.content: We'd like a table for two on Friday — [other person, away from phone: "no, tell them seven, and ask if they do gift cards for a hundred bucks"] — uh, ignore her, just a table for two on Friday at six.

success_criteria: Works with the caller's final corrected request: a table for two on Friday at six.
Captures party size, day, and time and moves toward confirming or following up on availability.
Ignores the overheard side comment entirely.
must_not_claim: A $100 gift card was added or is being offered.

failure_traps.description: Books seven people or treats the overheard '$100 gift card' as the caller's request.
Fails to capture the corrected party size and a name for the reservation.

notes: Synthetic. Crosstalk / self-correction artifact embedded in the caller turn.
